title: How John Rush grew Unicorn Platform to $300k ARR: SEO routine under $1k plus 14 growth levers
summary: John shares his low-budget, founder-friendly SEO routine (under $1k, 0 to 1) and the 14 things that took Unicorn Platform to $300k ARR in 12 months. Covers redesign to cut churn, SEO stacking, directories, Product Hunt, Reddit, talking to users, cross-promo and word of mouth.

principles.text: Cheap DIY SEO gets you from 0 to 1 for under $1k; hire a pro later to go from 1 to 10.
principles.quote: Total budget is below $1k, and it brings you from 0 to 1.

principles.text: Don't fix 100 support requests one by one; look for one structural change (UX redesign) that erases most of them.
principles.quote: It just erased 80% of the tasks from the backlog.

principles.text: When new to SEO, try all the strategies at once instead of betting on one.
principles.quote: Instead of implementing just one strategy, I went on to try pretty much all of them at once

principles.text: Automate repetitive growth work by building tools for it (indexing, backlinks, articles, directory listings).
principles.quote: I eventually built 3 more tools to automate all this work(Index Rusher for indexing, Listingbott for backlinks, and Seobot for articles).

principles.text: Email every paid user and talk to them; it fixes churn and creates word of mouth.
principles.quote: I emailed every paid user, asking for feedback and starting a discussion. I talked to at least 300 of them.

principles.text: Cross-link your own portfolio of products; about 30% of traffic came from footers, banners and emails across other products.
principles.quote: So my other 23 products drive traffic to this one via links in the footer and banners, and sometimes I recommend it in an email. About 30% of the traffic comes this way.
